name: aide-web-typescript
description: TypeScript toolchain for the progressive JS-to-TS migration. Runtime still loads the compiled .js artifacts; no bundler, no framework.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p internal/server/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p internal/server/web/tsconfig.worklets.json --noEmit && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.computer-bridge.json --noEmit && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.computer-bridge-linux.json --noEmit && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.headless-browser-bridge.json --noEmit && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.safari-bridge.json --noEmit
